dogecoin.text: @Dogecoin_Dan @Sthamber @simonateba @JDVance1 So while I’d like to think I can tell who’s lying & who actually cares, it actually doesn’t matter- what matters is the bills that are put up for a vote & who votes yay/nay. Every congressmember’s voting record is public.

@Dogecoin_Dan @Sthamber @simonateba @JDVance1 You focus on those policy wonks- now within those there is some trickery as well, but it at least lays the groundwork for potential compromise, which in a closely divided congress is vital to getting stuff done.  2/3

@Dogecoin_Dan @Sthamber @simonateba @JDVance1 You have to put in a lot of time to even understand the legal jargon, but once you’re over that hurdle, there’s a clear difference between the political grandstanding (which both Dem & GOP do) & the policy wonk type discussions. 1/3
